changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table project ( id uuid not null, name varchar(255) not null, objectifs text, description text, type varchar(20) not null check (type in ('PROJECT','PROGRAM')), status varchar(20) not null check (status in ('ACTIVE','TERMINATED','ARCHIVED')), chef_projet_id uuid not null, org_unit_id uuid not null, termination_year integer, created_by varchar(255), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone not null, primary key (id) );
alter table project add constraint fk_project_chef foreign key (chef_projet_id) references users (id);
alter table project add constraint fk_project_org_unit foreign key (org_unit_id) references org_unit (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists project cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table project_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, name varchar(255), objectifs text, description text, type varchar(20), status varchar(20), chef_projet_id uuid, org_unit_id uuid, termination_year integer, created_by varchar(255), created_at timestamp(6) with time zone, primary key (rev, id) );
alter table project_audit add constraint fk_project_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists project_audit cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table project_member ( id uuid not null, project_id uuid not null, user_id uuid not null, function_label varchar(100), primary key (id), constraint uk_project_member unique (project_id, user_id) );
alter table project_member add constraint fk_member_project foreign key (project_id) references project (id);
alter table project_member add constraint fk_member_user foreign key (user_id) references users (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists project_member cascade;

changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table project_member_audit ( id uuid not null, rev integer not null, revtype smallint, project_id uuid, user_id uuid, function_label varchar(100), primary key (rev, id) );
alter table project_member_audit add constraint fk_member_audit_revinfo foreign key (rev) references revinfo (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists project_member_audit cascade;
